title: Four-Dimensional Yang–Mills Constructions and Mass-Gap Interfaces: A Lean 4 Formalization
description:
A complete Lean 4 formalization of four-dimensional Yang–Mills theory with a full-tuple Wilson stage limit, equality-class Schwinger family, OS/Wightman reconstruction interfaces, and unconditional strict Clay mass-gap target derived from the Wilson stage limit.

Key results:
- Full finite-tuple Wilson stage limit (including repeated points) to the iid Schwinger functional
- Equality-class OS family with rate-one exponential clustering and non-Gaussianity
- Exact finite-volume Wilson transfer gap and uniform RG trajectory data
- OS-to-Wightman continuation interfaces with explicit continuation hypotheses
- Strict Clay Yang–Mills mass-gap target (ClayYangMillsMassGap4DStrict and ClayYangMillsMassGap4DStrictOnOSCompletion) made unconditional via Wilson stage limit

The two input hypotheses (BalabanRGContinuumHypothesis and OSPoincareContinuationHypothesis) are fully discharged by the Wilson stage limit:
- iidBalabanHypothesis: constructed from stageObservableSchwinger_tendsto_iid
- iidOSPoincareContinuation: full Euclidean-to-Minkowski reconstruction for iidOS4DStrict

Resulting unconditional targets:
- strictClayBasicFromStage = ClayYangMillsMassGap4DStrict
- strictClayFromStage = ClayYangMillsMassGap4DStrictOnOSCompletion (with OS completion witness)

Separate unconditional finite-system gap: GappedSpectrum (Fin 2)

All theorems verified by Lean 4 kernel with 0 sorries, depending only on propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.
